rows.counterargument: 'NEBRASKA/DELAWARE' IS NOT A LOCATION - it is two states 1,200 miles apart offered as alternatives in a cell that should hold one place. NO AIRCRAFT IN THIS FLEET WAS IN NEBRASKA ON 10 SEP 2025: the Lincoln rotation ran 17-23 August and did not resume until 5-11 October, so half the claimed location has no aircraft behind it at all. The Delaware half has an aircraft, but Wilmington is the aircraft's ordinary destination - it appears on the OUTBOUND leg of twenty-one rotations across three years, and ONLY ever the outbound leg. Erika Kirk has said she stayed home in Arizona with her mother that day. Neither version is independently documented.
rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. ERIKA'S SIDE IS THE WEAK SIDE and this row is the concrete form of it: the flight is audited and confirmed, the Kirk-side location is an unverified spreadsheet cell that the person it describes has contradicted. Her flight logs are reported erased - see site/docs/Planes/Erika-Flight-Logs-Erased.mdx. Erika Kirk is a living person, not charged with anything, named here only as the subject of a disputed claim she has denied.

ground_stay.notes: Provo-Wilmington 3:37, departing the morning of 10 September BEFORE the assassination. Wilmington-Cairo 9:43 on 11 September. Squawk 0000 on the Provo-Wilmington leg per the Flightradar24 playback card.
